label: Integer-multiple periods
subgoals: List the launch edges within one capture period
Pair each with the first strictly later capture edge
Take the smallest gap as the setup relationship

label: General periods over the common period
section: General periods over the common period
subgoals: Compute the least common multiple of the two periods
Pair every launch edge in that window with its next capture edge
Take the smallest gap as the setup relationship

label: Deriving the hold relationship
subgoals: Take the most restrictive setup pair
Compute the earlier capture edge against the launch and the capture edge against the next launch
Keep the larger value as the hold relationship
